app.title: Print Dock
tab.label: Label Layout & Print
common.storageDegraded: Storage is limited; config will not be saved (export JSON as backup)
label.multiAttachment: Only the first image is used when a cell has multiple attachments
label.pdfNote: Downloaded PDF is image-based (text not selectable); use Print → Save as PDF for searchable text
merge.batchNote: v1: batch DOCX download + single-record preview print; batch print/PDF comes in the next version
merge.templateSaved: Template saved; no need to re-upload after refresh
writeback.confirm: These records contain attachments not created by this plugin. Writing back will replace them. Continue?
label.tooNarrow: Cell width under 40mm — barcodes may become unscannable. Use fewer columns or a larger-cell preset.
label.noRenderable: None of the selected records have an image in the attachment field
receipt.rowSemantics: Each selected record = one item line on the receipt
receipt.fieldRequired: Please complete all three field mappings
receipt.noRenderable: No printable items (quantity/price must be positive)
receipt.skipped: Skipped {{count}} invalid record(s) (empty or non-positive quantity/price)
receipt.printNote: Select the driver-installed receipt printer (58mm paper) in the system print dialog
